content.summary: Water and fire protection solutions company Core & Main (NYSE:CNM) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2025, but sales rose 6.6% year on year to $2.09 billion. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $7.65 billion at the midpoint came in 1.7% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.87 per share was 10.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
